announce(uint256,address,bytes,bytes).details: The remaining metadata can be used by the senders however they like. See [ERC-5564](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-5564) for recommendations on how to structure this metadata.

params.ephemeralPubKey: Ephemeral public key used by the sender.
params.metadata: Arbitrary data to emit with the event. The first byte MUST be the view tag.
params.schemeId: Identifier corresponding to the applied stealth address scheme, e.g. 1 for secp256k1, as specified in ERC-5564.
params.stealthAddress: The computed stealth address for the recipient.

announce(uint256,address,bytes,bytes).notice: Called by integrators to emit an `Announcement` event.
